title: What Are the Mexican Wedding Traditions You Did Not Know?
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget

refresh_of.note: Person: article to refresh. Publish method: update in place, change slug and path to /expert-advice/mexican-wedding-traditions, confirm the old URL returns a 301. Check for duplicate Mexican traditions pages. Link (do not compete with) /destinations/latin-america-caribbean/mexico and /10-tips-for-planning-a-destination-wedding-in-mexico. Protect its rankings.

notes: REFRESH: the brief reads the old page with mcp__Apify__apify--web-fetch (one render-wait retry if the body is empty; if the call is DECLINED, do not retry and infer coverage from rankings). SEO pulls its ranked keywords (US and AU), checks duplicates, and the outline keeps covering every query with real volume. Never reuse wording; drop errors.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('In many Samoan families...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only.

DIVERSITY: customs vary by region and family, and some Indigenous communities keep their own; say so once and tie a custom to a region only where a source does. Spanish terms with accents as sources give them. Overlap: the Filipino draft shares arras, cord/lazo and sponsors; link only where natural, wording fresh.

Likely customs (brief finalises): padrinos and madrinas; the lazo; the arras (13 coins, no amounts); the Catholic Mass; the civil ceremony (the legal one); the callejoneada; mariachi; the money dance (no amounts); la vibora de la mar; Mexican wedding cookies and the cake; the tornaboda.
UNESCO only where its own text links an element to weddings (for example 'Mariachi, string music, song and trumpet', 2011). Confirm each page live and its title.

Destination angle: Smartraveller Mexico checked live (overall level and states at higher levels; suggest only places outside them; risks as Smartraveller words them). Legal from official sources only: Australian Embassy Mexico City (CNI, notarial), Smartraveller 'Getting married overseas' (recognition), Registro Civil steps only if an official page can be read; otherwise questions to ask the registry and the embassy, including any fees; 'as at November 2026'. Popular regions named only as places couples choose and only outside higher-level areas; no venue claims. Mexican-Australian weddings at home.
Sources: Mexico's culture ministry (gob.mx/cultura), tourism ministry, INAH, museums, UNESCO, encyclopaedias, academic sources. Never competitor wedding sites, vendor blogs or Wikipedia.

Links: /destinations/latin-america-caribbean/mexico, /10-tips-for-planning-a-destination-wedding-in-mexico, related traditions drafts (Filipino, Brazilian), /wonderland-concierge, /magazine. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=mexican-wedding-traditions&utm_content=primary|secondary.

Images: placeholders only; no AI images of people, cultural dress, ceremonies or places; AI only for neutral still lifes (a lazo, arras coins) labelled illustrative pending approval; old-page images only if licence confirmed.

Speed: WebFetch cannot reach outside sites; Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO from the start. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches (A: sponsors, lazo, arras, Mass and civil ceremony; B: procession, music and dances, food, UNESCO and legal), 15 min HARD by the clock, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders; self_qa.confidence must be a number; must_include_coverage entries must be objects with covered_by as an array; no extra sourcing rounds; never retry a declined call. Stop at the limit: start no new reads after 15 minutes.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md (single point of contact; fee and inclusions in writing); no implied help with legal or church paperwork.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; no vendor or venue names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
